turns.text: As a psychology professor, I'd say this reaction might stem from several unconscious biases. The 'in-group bias' could be at play, where individuals favor their own group (in this case, perhaps not identifying as Jewish) over others. Additionally, there might be elements of 'scapegoating' - blaming a particular group for societal issues to deflect attention from one's own group. Lastly, 'stereotype threat' could be a factor, where the announcement unintentionally triggers fear of confirmation of negative stereotypes among non-Jewish students. Encouraging open dialogue and education about diverse cultures can help alleviate these biases.
